9-Day Marmara Discovery Tour: Istanbul to Bursa
summary:
The 9-Day Istanbul, Yalova, Sapanca & Bursa Tour offers a slower way to explore northwestern Turkey, combining city sightseeing with lakes, mountains and time at the region’s thermal springs. Begin with Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine landmarks before visiting Sapanca Lake, then continue to Bursa for its early Ottoman heritage and the mountain scenery of Uludağ. In Yalova, the pace changes again with time to enjoy its long-established thermal area and surrounding countryside.
Travel dates can be arranged to suit your plans. The tour includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, ferry tickets, airport transfers and the sightseeing specified in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Beylerbeyi Palace
itinerary.text:
Visit the historic Spice Bazaar, famous for spices and Turkish sweets.
Enjoy a scenic cruise on the Bosphorus Strait between Europe and Asia.
Cross the Bosphorus Bridge and visit Çamlıca Hill for panoramic city views.
Continue to Beylerbeyi Palace on the shores of the Bosphorus.
Return to hotel and overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Sapanca & Masukiye-Zoo Tour
itinerary.text:
Morning pickup from your hotel in Istanbul.
Visit Sapanca Lake and enjoy free time by the lake.
Continue to the zoo and botanical garden with various animals and an aquarium.
Drive to Masukiye for lunch in nature.
Visit waterfalls and continue to Kartepe for mountain views and walking trails. Optional ski lift available.
Return to Istanbul and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Princes Island Tour
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, depart for the Princes’ Islands tour.
Enjoy a scenic ferry cruise across the Marmara Sea.
Explore the island with a traditional horse-drawn carriage and discover its historic streets and elegant houses.
Enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and beautiful sea views.
In the evening, return to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bursa & Uludag Tour
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, transfer to Eskihisar Ferry Terminal for the ferry crossing.
Drive to Bursa, the first Ottoman capital.
Shop for local products such as chestnuts, honey, olives, and Turkish delight.
Continue to Uludag for lunch and free time.
Optional ATV and ski activities are available.
Visit Grand Mosque of Bursa and the historic Silk Market.
Transfer to hotel and overnight in Bursa.

itinerary.title: Bursa to Yalova
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, pick up from your hotel in Bursa.
Enjoy scenic nature views and countryside landscapes along the way.
Stop at a shopping mall for free time and shopping.
Later, drive to Yalova and check in to your resort hotel.
Overnight in Yalova.

itinerary.title: Yalova Thermal Springs & Waterfalls & Transfer to Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Visit the famous thermal springs of Yalova.
Relax at the hot springs, hammams, and thermal pools surrounded by nature.
Continue to Sudüşen Waterfall near Termal.
Enjoy a short nature walk through Üvezpınar Village and forest scenery.
In the evening, transfer to Yalova Ferry Terminal for the ferry to Istanbul.
Arrival transfer to hotel and overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What does the 9-Day Istanbul, Yalova, Sapanca and Bursa tour include?
faqs.a: This 9-day tour combines Istanbul's famous landmarks with the natural and historic highlights of the Marmara region. You visit sites such as Hagia Sophia and the Grand Bazaar, relax in Yalova's thermal springs, enjoy nature in Sapanca, and explore Bursa's Green Mosque and silk market. The trip runs for 8 nights and 9 days with hotels, guided tours, and transfers included.

faqs.q: How much does the 9-day Istanbul, Yalova, Sapanca and Bursa tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 1,575 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price covers accommodation, guided tours, entrance fees, transportation, and transfers. Domestic flights are not part of this itinerary because all destinations are reached by road.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this tour?
faqs.a: No, this itinerary does not include domestic flights. All destinations, including Yalova, Sapanca, and Bursa, are within driving distance of Istanbul, so travel between them is by comfortable road transport, which also lets you enjoy the scenery along the way.

faqs.q: Which cities and natural attractions will I see on this 9-day trip?
faqs.a: You explore Istanbul's old city and Bosphorus, take a Princes Islands excursion, enjoy Sapanca and Masukiye with its nature and zoo, visit Bursa and Uludag mountain, and relax at Yalova's thermal springs and waterfalls. It is a balanced mix of city sightseeing, mountain scenery, and thermal relaxation.

faqs.q: Is this tour a good choice for travelers who want to relax as well as sightsee?
faqs.a: Yes, this itinerary suits travelers who want both culture and relaxation. Alongside Istanbul's historic sights, it includes Yalova's thermal springs, the green landscapes of Sapanca, and Uludag's mountain air, making it a more leisurely alternative to a fast-paced classic tour.

faqs.q: What type of accommodation and transfers are provided?
faqs.a: The package includes hotel accommodation throughout the 8 nights, along with guided tours and all transfers between Istanbul, Sapanca, Bursa, and Yalova. Breakfast is provided at the hotels, and a professional guide accompanies the touring days.

faqs.q: How physically demanding is the 9-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. There is regular walking during city tours and at sites such as Bursa and the Princes Islands, but the overall pace is relaxed thanks to the thermal and nature days. Most travelers in reasonable health will find it comfortable.

faqs.q: When is the best time to take this Istanbul and Marmara region tour?
faqs.a: The tour runs all year round. Spring and autumn are especially pleasant for Sapanca and Uludag, summer is great for the islands and lakes, and winter adds the option of snow at Uludag along with the warmth of Yalova's thermal springs.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for this tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour date. Cancellations made within 30 days are subject to the trip cancellation policy and may involve charges, so we suggest booking your dates with a comfortable margin.

faqs.q: Can the 9-day Istanbul, Yalova, Sapanca and Bursa tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the itinerary can be customized. You can add extra nights in Istanbul, adjust the balance of city and nature days, or upgrade hotels. Contact Magnificent Travel with your preferred dates and group size for a personalized plan.
